s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive visual impairment with night blindness and peripheral visual field defects
salient_findings: Night blindness since childhood
Inferonasal scotoma on Goldmann visual field
Abnormal electroretinogram with flat rod response
Hypofluorescence on fundus autofluorescence
Inner retinal thickening and disorganization on OCT
key_facts: Patient age 42
Symptoms present since childhood
No symptoms except night blindness
Visual acuity 20/25 to 20/30 in both eyes
Color vision normal
Fundus examination shows few yellow spots and indistinct grayish circle
ERG shows large, slow scotopic and photopic responses
ERG shows flat rod electroretinogram
ERG amplitudes lower compared to 30 years ago
Fundus autofluorescence shows hypofluorescence in superotemporal zones
OCT shows supernormal thickness in perifoveal region
OCT shows marked inner retinal thickening and disorganization in eccentric areas
Complete loss of photoreceptors, ellipsoid zone, and retinal pigment epithelium in superotemporal region

shortlist.label: Retinitis pigmentosa
shortlist.why_kept: Night blindness since childhood, flat rod electroretinogram, and peripheral visual field defects

shortlist.label: Choroideremia
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive visual impairment, night blindness, and marked inner retinal thickening and disorganization

shortlist.label: Gyrate atrophy
shortlist.why_kept: Night blindness, peripheral visual field defects, and supernormal thickness in perifoveal region

shortlist.label: Leber congenital amaurosis
shortlist.why_kept: Night blindness since childhood, and marked inner retinal thickening and disorganization

shortlist.label: Cone-rod dystrophy
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive visual impairment, night blindness, and abnormal electroretinogram responses

raw.rationale: The patient's night blindness since childhood, flat rod electroretinogram, and peripheral retinal degeneration with loss of photoreceptors are consistent with retinitis pigmentosa.

rejected.label: Choroideremia
rejected.why: Choroideremia typically presents with more severe visual impairment and earlier loss of color vision.

rejected.label: Gyrate atrophy
rejected.why: Gyrate atrophy is associated with ornithine aminotransferase deficiency and typically presents with myopia and peripheral retinal degeneration, but the patient's ERG and OCT findings do not support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Leber congenital amaurosis
rejected.why: Leber congenital amaurosis typically presents with severe visual impairment and nystagmus in infancy, which is not consistent with the patient's history.

rejected.label: Cone-rod dystrophy
rejected.why: Cone-rod dystrophy typically presents with decreased visual acuity and color vision defects, which are not prominent in this patient's presentation.
